items.question: How do I download Instagram photos?
items.answer: Copy the link of the Instagram post you want to save by tapping the share button. Paste the URL into the InstaDown input field and click Download to save the original high-quality photo.

items.question: Can I download Instagram Reels videos?
items.answer: Yes, you can download Instagram Reels videos. Simply copy the Reels post URL and paste it to save the video in MP4 format.

items.question: Can I save carousel posts with multiple photos?
items.answer: Yes, you can download all photos and videos from carousel (slideshow) posts individually or save them all at once with the 'Download All' button.

items.question: Is this Instagram download service free?
items.answer: Yes, InstaDown is completely free. You can use it without signing up or installing any app, with no download limits.

items.question: Can I download posts from private accounts?
items.answer: No, only posts from public accounts can be downloaded. Posts from private accounts are only visible to their followers and cannot be downloaded.

items.question: What is the quality of downloaded photos?
items.answer: Photos are downloaded in their original resolution as uploaded to Instagram. You get the highest quality images without any compression.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: InstaDown ("Service") values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information in accordance with applicable laws. This Privacy Policy explains what information is collected when you use the Service and how it is used.
privacy.section1Content:
Our Service does not require account registration and collects minimal information.

- Instagram URLs submitted by users: These are temporarily processed for media extraction and are not stored.
- Automatically collected information: Basic information such as IP address, browser type, and access time may be recorded in server logs for service operation.
- Cookies: We may use cookies to enhance your experience and to serve advertisements.
privacy.section2Content:
Collected information is used only for the following purposes:

- Providing the Instagram media download service
- Improving service quality and fixing errors
- Analyzing service usage statistics
- Serving personalized advertisements (Google AdSense)
privacy.section3Content:
This Service may use the following third-party services, each governed by their own privacy policies:

- Google AdSense: Uses cookies to serve personalized advertisements. For more information, see Google's Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy).
- Google Analytics: May be used for analyzing service usage statistics.
- Vercel: Used for hosting and delivering the Service.
privacy.section4Content: This Service does not store Instagram URLs submitted by users. URLs are discarded immediately after media extraction is complete. Server logs are retained for up to 90 days for security and service improvement purposes, after which they are automatically deleted.
privacy.section5Content: You can change or delete cookie settings at any time through your browser settings. You may also refuse cookie collection. However, refusing cookies may limit some features of the Service.
privacy.section6Content: This Service does not intentionally collect personal information from children under the age of 13. If we become aware that a child under 13 has provided personal information, we will promptly delete such information.
privacy.section7Content: This Privacy Policy may be updated to reflect changes in laws or the Service. Any changes will be posted on this page.
privacy.section8Content:
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

Email: support@instadownload.me

download.title: How to Download Instagram Posts
download.metaTitle: How to Download Instagram Posts - Photo & Reels Guide | InstaDown
download.metaDescription: Learn how to download Instagram photos and reels for free. Save original high-quality media in 3 simple steps.
download.subtitle: Save Instagram photos and reels for free
download.content:
## What is Instagram Downloading?

Instagram doesn't provide an official way to download photos or videos. With InstaDown, you can save photos and reels from public posts in their original quality.

## How to Download

### Step 1: Copy the Link
On the Instagram app, tap the **share button (···)** on the post you want to save and select **'Copy Link'**.

### Step 2: Paste the URL
Paste the copied URL into the InstaDown input field and click **'Download'**.

### Step 3: Save
Click the download button on the extracted photo or video to save it. For carousel posts, use 'Download All' to save everything at once.

## Supported Content

- **Photo posts**: Download single photos in original quality
- **Reels**: Save videos in MP4 format
- **Carousels**: Download multiple photos/videos individually or in bulk

## Important Notes

- Only public posts can be downloaded.
- Downloaded content is copyrighted by the original creator.
- Unauthorized commercial use is prohibited.

lineBreak.title: How to Add Line Breaks on Instagram
lineBreak.metaTitle: How to Add Line Breaks on Instagram - Caption & Bio Guide | InstaDown
lineBreak.metaDescription: Learn how to fix disappearing line breaks in Instagram captions and bios.
lineBreak.subtitle: Keep your line breaks in Instagram captions and bios
lineBreak.content:
## Why Do Line Breaks Disappear?

When typing text on Instagram, pressing Enter often results in line breaks disappearing. This happens because Instagram automatically removes consecutive blank lines.

## The Solution

### Method: Use InstaDown Line Break Tool
1. Enter your text in the **Line Break tool**.
2. Press Enter twice where you want line breaks.
3. Click the **'Copy'** button.
4. Paste into Instagram and your line breaks will be preserved.

### How It Works
This tool inserts an **invisible special character (U+200B, Zero-Width Space)** between blank lines. Instagram recognizes this character, so the blank lines are not removed.

## Tips

- **Organize captions**: Separate content into paragraphs for better readability.
- **Bio layout**: Arrange information neatly line by line.
- **Lists**: Format items in a list for a clean look.

blankSpace.title: How to Use Instagram Blank Spaces
blankSpace.metaTitle: How to Use Instagram Blank Spaces - Guide | InstaDown
blankSpace.metaDescription: Learn how to use invisible blank characters to organize your Instagram bio and captions.
blankSpace.subtitle: Guide to using special blank characters on Instagram
blankSpace.content:
## What are Instagram Blank Spaces?

Regular spacebar spaces are not recognized as blank lines on Instagram. Using a special Unicode character (U+3164, Hangul Filler) creates blank lines that Instagram preserves.

## How to Use

1. Select the number of blank spaces in the **Blank Space tool**.
2. Click the **'Copy'** button.
3. Paste into your Instagram bio or caption.

## Use Cases

- **Bio sections**: Separate name, job, contact info with blank lines
- **Caption spacing**: Add space between text and hashtags
- **Aesthetic layout**: Create a clean, organized profile look

fonts.title: How to Use Instagram Fonts
fonts.metaTitle: How to Use Instagram Fonts - Special Font Guide | InstaDown
fonts.metaDescription: Learn how to use bold, italic, script, and other special fonts in Instagram bios and captions.
fonts.subtitle: Use special fonts on Instagram
fonts.content:
## What are Instagram Special Fonts?

Instagram doesn't offer font customization by default. However, using Unicode mathematical symbols and special characters, you can display various font styles.

## How to Use

1. Enter your English text in the **Font Generator**.
2. Choose from 15 available styles.
3. Click the **'Copy'** button.
4. Paste into Instagram.

## Available Styles

Bold, Italic, Script, Fraktur, Double-Struck, Sans-Serif, Monospace, Circled, Squared, Fullwidth, and more — **15 styles** total.

## Notes

- Only English letters and numbers are converted.
- Some characters may display differently on certain devices.

characterCounter.title: How to Count Instagram Characters
characterCounter.metaTitle: Instagram Character Counter Guide - Check Limits | InstaDown
characterCounter.metaDescription: Learn how to check Instagram character limits for captions (2,200), bios (150), and hashtags (30).
characterCounter.subtitle: Check Instagram character limits
characterCounter.content:
## Instagram Character Limits

- **Caption**: Up to 2,200 characters
- **Bio**: Up to 150 characters
- **Hashtags**: Up to 30 per post
- **Comments**: Up to 2,200 characters
- **Username**: Up to 30 characters

## How to Use

1. Enter your text in the **Character Counter tool**.
2. See real-time counts for characters, words, lines, hashtags, and mentions.
3. Monitor progress bars showing how close you are to each limit.

## Tips

- Captions exceeding 2,200 characters cannot be posted.
- More than 30 hashtags may disable commenting.
- Keep your bio concise — 150 characters is quite short.

imageResizer.title: How to Resize Images for Instagram
imageResizer.metaTitle: Instagram Image Resizer Guide - Optimal Sizes | InstaDown
imageResizer.metaDescription: Learn the optimal image sizes for Instagram and how to resize your photos for feed, stories, and reels.
imageResizer.subtitle: Guide to optimal Instagram image sizes
imageResizer.content:
## Recommended Instagram Image Sizes

- **Feed (Square)**: 1080 × 1080px
- **Feed (Portrait)**: 1080 × 1350px
- **Feed (Landscape)**: 1080 × 566px
- **Story/Reels**: 1080 × 1920px
- **Profile Picture**: 110 × 110px

## How to Use

1. Upload your image to the **Image Resizer**.
2. Select a preset or enter custom dimensions.
3. Preview and click **'Download'**.

## Tips

- Enable **Keep Ratio** to prevent image distortion.
- Portrait photos (1080×1350) take up more feed space and get more attention.
- Center important elements in profile photos since they're cropped to a circle.

reelsThumbnail.title: How to Extract Reels Thumbnails
reelsThumbnail.metaTitle: Reels Thumbnail Extraction Guide - Cover Image Download | InstaDown
reelsThumbnail.metaDescription: Learn how to extract and download Instagram Reels thumbnails (cover images).
reelsThumbnail.subtitle: Extract Reels cover images
reelsThumbnail.content:
## What is a Reels Thumbnail?

A Reels thumbnail is the cover image that represents the video on your profile grid. It's useful for referencing or saving thumbnail designs from other creators.

## How to Extract

1. Copy the **share link** from an Instagram Reel.
2. Paste the URL into the **Reels Thumbnail Extractor**.
3. Click **'Extract Thumbnail'**.
4. Download the extracted thumbnail.

## Tips

- Study popular Reels thumbnails for design inspiration.
- Thumbnails significantly impact Reels view counts.
- Text-based thumbnails tend to attract more viewer attention.
